description: Website wrapper in browser mode — full tabs, save-as-app, no manifest-driven features

capabilities.expected: Window opens, loads https://example.com. Window title from page <title>.

capabilities.test: Launch installed WS app that has icon in metadata JSON
capabilities.expected: Window icon shows app icon (not generic Qt icon).

capabilities.test: Launch two different WS apps, verify settings are separate
capabilities.expected: Each app uses QSettings(QAppFramework, qapp-{appId}). Window size, tabs, profile settings independent.
Single tab loads startUrl from argv[2].
New tab created loading startUrl. Tab appears in bar.

capabilities.test: With 2+ tabs, click X on a tab
capabilities.expected: Tab closed, view destroyed. Adjacent tab selected. X button hidden when only 1 tab remains.

capabilities.test: Click different tabs in tab bar
capabilities.expected: Correct WebEngineView visible. Other views hidden. Tab bar highlights active tab.
Tab title in bar updates to page title. Elides at ~200px.

capabilities.test: Open 3 tabs with different URLs. Close window. Relaunch same appId.
capabilities.expected: All 3 tabs restored with their URLs. Saved in QSettings {appId}/tabs.

capabilities.test: Click link that uses window.open() or target=_blank
capabilities.expected: New tab created with target URL. Window.opener relationship preserved.
All navigation stays in-app (no scope = no restriction). Browser mode has no scope.
Context menu with Back (disabled if no history), Forward (disabled if at end), Reload.

capabilities.feature: Context menu — Open link in new tab
capabilities.expected: 'Open link in new tab' menu item. Creates new tab with link URL.
'Copy link address' copies URL to clipboard.
'Copy image' and 'Copy image address' items available.
'Copy' menu item. Copies selected text.

capabilities.feature: Tab bar visible in browser mode
capabilities.test: Launch WS app (no metadata or displayMode=browser)
capabilities.expected: Full header with tab bar, + button, hamburger menu.

capabilities.feature: No back/forward buttons in browser mode
capabilities.test: Observe header in browser display mode
capabilities.expected: No back/forward buttons (those appear only in minimal-ui mode).
'Save as app...' visible and enabled.
Dialog with app name field (pre-filled with page title), current URL shown below.

capabilities.test: Fill name, click OK in save dialog
capabilities.expected: qapp-installer launched with URL and --name arguments. Status message in footer.
Dialog with Data Management, HTTP Cache, JS Heap, User Agent sections.

capabilities.test: Change cache size in settings (100-10000 MB)
capabilities.expected: Value persisted to QSettings. Applied to WebEngineProfile.httpCacheMaximumSize.

capabilities.test: Change JS heap size in settings (512-32768 MB)
capabilities.expected: Value persisted. Note: requires restart to take effect (Chromium flag set at startup).
UA string stored. Requires restart. Options: Auto (Chrome-like), Chrome/131, Firefox/133, Edge/131, Custom.
TextField appears. Custom string persisted and used after restart.
Window closes. WebEngine profile data deleted (~/.../QtWebEngine/{appId}/). App relaunches fresh.

capabilities.test: Resize/move window. Close. Relaunch same appId.
capabilities.expected: Window opens at saved x, y, width, height.
Window goes fullscreen, header hidden. Press F11 again: exits fullscreen, header returns.

capabilities.test: Press F11 for first time with this appId
capabilities.expected: 'Press F11 to exit fullscreen' hint shows. Fades after 3s. Never shown again for this appId.
Hamburger menu opens.

capabilities.test: Click download link on a web page
capabilities.expected: Save-as FileDialog opens. After save: download bar shows filename + progress + cancel button.

capabilities.test: Start download, click cancel in download bar
capabilities.expected: Download cancelled. Bar disappears.

capabilities.test: Log in to site. Close app. Relaunch.
capabilities.expected: Still logged in. Cookies persist (ForcePersistentCookies policy).
Cached resources load from disk.

capabilities.test: Log in on appId=A. Launch appId=B for same site.
capabilities.expected: Not logged in on B. Each appId has separate WebEngine profile/storage.

capabilities.test: Switch to another window for >500ms. Switch back.
capabilities.expected: Semi-transparent overlay with spinner shows briefly, then fades out (2s). WebEngine reactivated.
Dialog with version, tagline, links.
Opens https://eupl.eu/1.2/en/ in system browser.
